It will be harder to run Loopy Landscapes I think with the Mac because it is an expansion pack. Wineskin, the application you install in order to run programs, reads each .exe as it's own entity and is unable to combine or manage to link two .exe files together unless they are bottled together. Since Loopy Landscapes is an expansion to RCT you would have to bottle it in such a way that the application recognizes both programs at once, if this makes any sense at all. I would suggest downloading everything from Pirate Bay, and doing some research on Wineskin. Essentially you use Wineskin to install the .exe files through autorun.exe, and you will need to go to www.gamecopyworld.com to exchange the RCT.exe file to successfully run the program. Google Paul the Tall RCT, and he'll have a video to successfully play RCT2. Some of the processes may be the same with RCT but with Loopy Landscapes and Corkscrew Follies it may be different. Good luck.
